about: Money as a reply shows it: whole VND with the currency symbol, in each reply language (docs/02 §2.11.2 "Same numbers in JS and Python"). The strings come from Node's Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' }), which is what server/src/bot/core.js money() uses, written out so that the agent service's money.py (T45, pytest) and Express (server/test/money.test.js) must give the same text. The gap before the dong sign in Vietnamese is a no-break space (\u00a0); the sign is U+20AB. A negative amount puts the minus before the number in Vietnamese and before the symbol in English.
